title: dpe-hw: AES key copies left on the stack by the host AES path
description: Building the aes cipher moves it between stack slots, and the moved-from copies are never wiped. The crate is no_std with no allocator, so the AES helpers are now #[inline(never)] and wipe_callee_stack() zeroes 4 KiB after each call. Host emulation only; firmware uses the hardware AES engine.
